mapper.sql: handover.id, handover.tenant_id, handover.handover_no, handover.fulfillment_order_id, handover.handover_status, handover.vehicle_plate, handover.driver_name, handover.driver_phone, handover.departure_time, handover.destination, handover.freight_cost, handover.currency, handover.logistics_photo_file_ids, handover.remark, handover.handover_time, handover.handover_by, handover.version, handover.create_by, handover.create_time, handover.update_by, handover.update_time, fulfillment.erp_tenant_id, owner.tenant_name AS owner_name, fulfillment.warehouse_id, warehouse.warehouse_name, fulfillment.fulfillment_no, fulfillment.source_type, fulfillment.source_order_no, fulfillment.recipient_name, fulfillment.recipient_address, fulfillment.carrier_name, fulfillment.shipping_method, fulfillment.tracking_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(operator.nickname, ''), operator.username) AS handover_by_name

FROM wms_outbound_handover_order handover INNER JOIN wms_fulfillment_order fulfillment ON fulfillment.id = handover.fulfillment_order_id AND fulfillment.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_tenant owner ON owner.id = fulfillment.erp_tenant_id AND owner.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse warehouse ON warehouse.id = fulfillment.warehouse_id AND warehouse.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.user_id = handover.handover_by AND operator.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE handover.id = #{id} AND handover.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND handover.deleted = 0

SELECT fulfillment.id, fulfillment.erp_tenant_id, owner.tenant_name AS owner_name, fulfillment.warehouse_id, warehouse.warehouse_name, fulfillment.fulfillment_no, fulfillment.source_type, fulfillment.source_order_no, fulfillment.fulfillment_status, fulfillment.recipient_name, fulfillment.recipient_address, fulfillment.carrier_name, fulfillment.shipping_method, fulfillment.tracking_no, fulfillment.package_weight_kg, fulfillment.create_time FROM wms_fulfillment_order fulfillment LEFT JOIN sys_tenant owner ON owner.id = fulfillment.erp_tenant_id AND owner.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse warehouse ON warehouse.id = fulfillment.warehouse_id AND warehouse.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_outbound_handover_order handover ON handover.fulfillment_order_id = fulfillment.id AND handover.deleted = 0 WHERE fulfillment.deleted = 0 AND fulfillment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND fulfillment.fulfillment_status = 'PACKED' AND handover.id IS NULL ORDER BY fulfillment.packed_time ASC, fulfillment.id ASC
SELECT destination FROM wms_outbound_handover_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND destination IS NOT NULL AND destination <> '' GROUP BY destination ORDER BY MAX(id) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM wms_outbound_handover_order WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
